time_limits.name: Time limits (quiet hours, daily limit)
time_limits.description: Nothing plays in quiet hours, and a daily limit fades the sound out when the day's listening time is used up. Parents can add time with one action.

quiet_hours.label: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.help: Times when nothing plays, for example the night

end.label: Until
end.help: Time of day, e.g. 07:00 (the next morning if it is earlier than the start)

days.label: On
days.help: The day the quiet hours start on

weekend_limit_minutes.label: Listening time on weekends (minutes)
weekend_limit_minutes.help: Empty: the same as on other days; 0: no limit

warn_minutes.label: Warn before the limit (minutes)
warn_minutes.help: Plays the warning sound this long before the time is up. 0: no warning

fade_seconds.label: Fade out over (seconds)
fade_seconds.help: When the limit is reached while something plays

warning_sound.label: Sound for the warning
warning_sound.help: A sound file in the home directory; empty: none

blocked_sound.label: Sound when playback is blocked
blocked_sound.help: A sound file in the home directory; empty: none
